title: Charlene Hubbs
summary: Charlene Hubbs is a Suit working for the Organization. She mainly works in Venice, Italy and was previously commanded by DeFoe.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Hubbs helped surround Dante's house, under orders from DeFoe and Grier to retrieve Eathon Lambert's journal from Lok Lambert, Cherit and Dante Vale. [A Seeker Is Born] Hubbs and her fellow Suits pursued the three along the rooftops of Venice but failed to stop them. [The Casterwill Client]

At Road of Alchemists, Hubbs invoked a Mindrone to fight Lok's Freelancer but it was defeated. She and Mr. Koskin both hit Lok with an Augerfrost, rendering him unconscious. DeFoe order the group to retreat when Dante retrieved and invoked Metagolem. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

Hubbs later attacked Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill with Mr. Koskin and Unnamed Suit 004 at a burger restaurant where the Huntik team were trying earn enough to travel to Egypt. Hubbs was defeated when Santiago used her to shield himself from a Raypulse attack from one of Hubbs' colleagues. [All Work and No Pay]

full_text:
Charlene Hubbs is a Suit working for the Organization. She mainly works in Venice, Italy and was previously commanded by DeFoe.

History

Hubbs helped surround Dante's house, under orders from DeFoe and Grier to retrieve Eathon Lambert's journal from Lok Lambert, Cherit and Dante Vale. [A Seeker Is Born] Hubbs and her fellow Suits pursued the three along the rooftops of Venice but failed to stop them. [The Casterwill Client]

At Road of Alchemists, Hubbs invoked a Mindrone to fight Lok's Freelancer but it was defeated. She and Mr. Koskin both hit Lok with an Augerfrost, rendering him unconscious. DeFoe order the group to retreat when Dante retrieved and invoked Metagolem. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

Hubbs later attacked Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill with Mr. Koskin and Unnamed Suit 004 at a burger restaurant where the Huntik team were trying earn enough to travel to Egypt. Hubbs was defeated when Santiago used her to shield himself from a Raypulse attack from one of Hubbs' colleagues. [All Work and No Pay]

Abilities

Like most Suits, Hubbs was issued with the standard Organization Titans.

Spells Utilized

• Augerfrost
• Hyperstride

Bonded Titans

• Mindrone
• Tolivane (TCG)

Trivia

• Hubbs' first name was revealed in the Adventure Game on Huntik.com. She is the only Suit, other than Zhalia Moon, whose full name has been revealed.
